comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
DONE. c6c9 closed.

Change 1405 merged to main as 094c4c4525 (Gerrit rebased server-side; my pre-submit local was 5e08c9053db). Replicated to the GitHub mirror — origin/main carries attest.py 656 and remediation_mode.py 182.

Close sequence note for future runs: checking the AC boxes (adding per-item evidence text) changed the material fingerprint and tripped the plan-review close gate with 'stale-material'. Fixed by re-running review-plan (PASS, now certified against 094c4c4525) and retrying the close — NOT by --force-close. Worth knowing that AC-box evidence edits invalidate the claim-time attestation.

Final board state:
  c6c9-cba0-1aa4-47eb (scathing-washable-sapsucker) CLOSED — 4 ACs checked with evidence, 5th is [operator-attested] and exempt.
  8705-5c65-c1b6-42de (valiant-balladic-willet) OPEN — passes.py at 800/800, discovered_from c6c9.

Residual gaps: none beyond the filed follow-up. No test exclusions, no escalation compromises, no deferred blocking findings (LLM-Review had zero findings). The two plan-review advisories were dispositioned in an earlier comment (E4 accepted + corrected; P6 not applicable).
